name: block-hero-centered
use: The first screen of a page without a picture: a badge, a title of at most two lines, one sentence, one or two actions and, if needed, three steps.
avoid: A first screen that needs a picture or a figure beside the title; any place but the first screen of a page.
props: { kind: 'block-hero-centered'; pill?: string; title: string; description: string; cta?: { label: string; href: string }; secondary?: { label: string; href: string }; steps?: [{ title: string; text: string }, { title: string; text: string }, { title: string; text: string }] }

variants.label: With three steps under the actions

cases.title: Home page of a service: what it is and two actions
cases.why: With no picture, the title and the actions are the whole offer of the first screen.

cases.title: Launch page that shows how to start in three steps
